results.title: SEG Solar opens 4 GW Tomball factory; previously announced third facility would push total to 10.6 GW
results.author: Hugo Rojas
highlights:
SEG Solar opens

SEG Solar opened a new 4-gigawatt solar module assembly plant in Tomball, Texas on August 7, marking one of the largest single-facility additions to American solar module manufacturing capacity in recent years.
...
The SEG Solar Tomball facility officially opened on August 7, 2026, as a 4 GW solar module assembly plant. Once fully operational next year, it will bring SEG’s annual module assembly capacity to 6 GW, joining the company’s original 2 GW facility in nearby Houston.
...
SEG Solar announced plans on June 1, 2026 to develop a third U.S. manufacturing facility in Greater Houston, Texas. The new 4.6 GW facility is expected to bring SEG’s planned annual U.S. module manufacturing capacity to 10.6 GW. As part of the grand opening ceremonies, the company reiterated plans to build the additional 4.6 GW module assembly factory within 18 months. The new facility would be located across the street from the Tomball plant and bring the company’s total annual capacity to 10.6 GW, making it the largest crystalline silicon solar module assembler in the United States.

results.title: SEG Solar Inaugurates Second U.S. PV Module Manufacturing Facility-SEG Solar
results.author: 上海雍熙,https://www.yongsy.com
highlights:
On August 7, 2026, SEG Solar (“SEG”), a leading U.S. solar module manufacturer, officially inaugurated its second U.S. PV module manufacturing facility (Tomball #1) in Greater Houston, Texas, expanding its total U.S. module manufacturing capacity to 6 GW annually. The opening marks another major milestone in SEG's journey toward becoming the largest crystalline solar module manufacturer in the United States and further reinforces the company's long-term commitment to strengthening domestic solar manufacturing.
...
Representing an investment of US$200 million and spanning more than 500,000 square feet, Tomball #1 is SEG's largest module manufacturing facility in the United States and one of the country's largest HJT module manufacturing facilities. With an annual production capacity of 4 GW, the facility features four advanced production lines dedicated to manufacturing SEG's latest-generation high-efficiency SIERRA N series HJT modules, supporting both 210 mm and 210R wafer formats. The facility incorporates specialized HJT manufacturing processes, further enhancing module reliability, long-term durability, and energy yield.

results.title: SEG Solar Announces New US 4 GW Solar Module Factory-SEG Solar
results.author: 上海雍熙,https://www.yongsy.com
highlights:
HOUSTON – May 7, 2026 – SEG Solar (“SEG”), a leading U.S. solar module manufacturer, today announced that it will establish a new 4-gigawatt (GW) solar manufacturing facility in Houston, Texas. Building on the success of its first 2 GW solar module factory, this expansion will increase SEG’s total annual U.S. module production capacity to approximately 6 GW. Commercial operations at the new facility are expected to commence in Q3 2026.
...
